Mode.Name: Complexity
Mode.Hint: How much rules weight a trade carries. Each feature can still be turned on or off on its own.

Tables.Name: Price tables
Tables.Hint: Prices, rates and rounding steps that differ from the defaults.

Error.NoGM: A GM must be online to trade.
Error.NoAnswer: The GM did not answer. Try again.

Open.Label: Open
Open.Hint: Players can trade here only while the shop is open.

ExecutionMode.Label: Trades
ExecutionMode.Hint: Instant trades go through as soon as the offer balances. With GM approval, you approve, counter or decline each one.

Stock.Label: Shelf
Stock.Hint: Items on this actor are its stock. Equipped and natural items stay with the merchant. Leave a price empty to use the item's value.
Stock.Empty: This actor has no items to sell. Drop items onto its sheet to stock the shelf.
